description: This file defines a utility enum ToolResultTextFormatter that provides static methods for formatting and rendering JSON-based tool results into human-readable strings. It handles JSON detection, parsing, error message extraction, and summarization of nodes information.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the input text based on whether it is JSON and the toolName provided, returning a human-readable string.

methods.name: looksLikeJSON
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be JSON by inspecting its first character.

methods.name: renderJSON
methods.description: Converts JSON objects or arrays into formatted strings, summarizing if needed.

methods.name: renderDictionary
methods.description: Renders a JSON dictionary into a user-friendly message, handling errors, statuses, and nodes summaries.

methods.name: renderNodesSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary string for a list of nodes, including details like connection status and platform.

methods.name: pairingDetail
methods.description: Determines if a node requires pairing based on its status fields.

methods.name: firstString
methods.description: Retrieves the first non-empty string value from a dictionary for a list of possible keys.

methods.name: sanitizeError
methods.description: Cleans and truncates raw error messages for improved readability.
